name: Sal
physical_description: A male humanoid tree frog with bright green skin, a pale cream-white belly and chest, and orange hands and feet. Black tribal-style markings with yellow accents run along the arms, sides, and knees. Large red eyes with vertical slit pupils and a yellow stripe down the center of the forehead.
main_outfit_description: No clothing - the markings and colouring are the whole look.
